title: Pre-Greek: The lost language hidden within Ancient Greek
summary: This article explores Pre-Greek, a hypothesized substrate language (or languages) that existed in the Aegean region before the arrival of Proto-Greek speakers. It examines linguistic evidence including place names, suffixes like -nth- and -ss-, and borrowed vocabulary to reconstruct what we know about this lost language.
problem_solved: Investigates what pre-Indo-European languages existed in the Greek-speaking world and how they influenced the Greek language we know today.
why_valuable: Provides accessible analysis of complex linguistic archaeology, helping readers understand how we can detect and study languages that left no written records.
